speaker: イカロス
jp: 頭をなでていただけますか……？
en: Would you... pat me on the head...?

speaker: 智樹
jp: どうして頭をなでてほしかったんだ？
en: Why'd you want a head pat?

speaker: イカロス

en: Before, I saw Nymph getting her head patted... and, um, I wanted that too...

en: (Well, if she's satisfied, I guess this is fine.)
